limitations: Agent review, not human labeling or qualified external assessment.
Frozen commit was supplied; repository history not independently inspected.
Historical lexical overlap check belongs to root and was not independently executed here. No historical question content was supplied. Lexical checks cannot establish semantic independence.
No runtime behavior, retrieval performance, scoring implementation, upload indexing or project authorization execution was tested.
All departments are null, so the suite does not independently test department isolation.
Synthetic policy domain and repeated policy facts across allowed/denied, memory and conflict cases limit diversity; this is not broad enterprise generalization evidence.
Context separation cannot prove absence of latent model knowledge.
